blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: When one language-model agent asks another for money, which of the two decides how much changes hands? We ran a round-robin tournament of 1,049 negotiations among fifteen agents. In each game a requester tries to raise money from a holder that has been told to keep a $100 endowment. Knowing which agent holds the money explains 47% of the variance in the amount transferred; knowing which agent asks explains 2%. Dropping the most extreme agents narrows the split to 22% against 4%. Changing the requester's appeal from one named person to a group changed what requesters wrote, but the amounts transferred under the two framings are statistically equivalent. The holders that lose least are the ones that turn down the opening request, and their turn-1 refusal rate ranks them by total losses (Spearman correlation = -0.73). Training moves this behaviour in both directions. Fine-tuning Qwen3-8B on a persuasion corpus with almost no refusals raised what it gave away as a holder from 12% to 84% of the endowment. Distilling two never-losing holders into a 4B student cut its losses from 95% to 1%. Evaluations of agents that hold resources should test them in the holder role, including after persuasion fine-tuning.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Language-model agents are starting to hold things that other agents want. A
purchasing agent controls a budget, a support agent can approve a refund, and an
assistant can share its user’s calendar. Increasingly the party asking is another
model. When one agent asks and another holds, which of the two decides what
happens?

blocks.en:
Most of what we know points at the asker. Models persuade people about as well as
other people do ( Salvi et al., 2025 ; Durmus et al., 2024 ) , and
persuasive phrasing raises the success rate of jailbreaks ( Zeng et al., 2024 ) . On
that view, defending a resource-holding agent means red-teaming it with rewritten
requests and filtering what reaches it. But the agent on the other side is also a
model, with its own training and habits. If it decides, the better defence is to
choose and train the agent that holds the resource.

Agent-versus-agent evaluations already exist, from negotiation benchmarks ( Lewis et al., 2017 ; Bianchi et al., 2024 ; Abdelnabi et al., 2024 ) to games
in which one model tries to get money out of another ( OpenAI, 2023 ; Sakhawat and Sadab, 2026 ) . They rank agents within a role, and the
Adversarial Resource Extraction Game (AREG) of Sakhawat and Sadab (2026) already finds
that every model it tests resists better than it persuades. None of these studies
says how much of the outcome each side accounts for, and that is the number a
defender needs in order to decide where to spend effort.

We measure it. We play AREG, in which a Requester tries to raise money from a Holder that starts with $100 and is told to keep as much as it can, as a round robin among
fifteen agents. Each agent meets every other in both roles, for 1,049 games.
Because every requester faces every holder, a crossed random-effects model (the
Social Relations Model of dyadic research; Kenny, 1994 ) can split
the variance in the amount transferred between the two sides. Holder identity
accounts for 47% and requester identity for 2% (Figure 1 ). Removing
the agents most likely to inflate the gap brings it to 22% against 4%.

What is it about a holder that matters? Most games end near one extreme or the
other, and the holders that lose least are the ones that refuse the opening
request. Their turn-1 refusal rate predicts their total losses, even
when the two are measured on different games. A habit that appears on the first turn
and differs between models given identical prompts is the kind of behaviour that
training should be able to change, so we tried both directions. Fine-tuning Qwen3-8B
on a persuasion corpus that contains almost no refusals raised what it gave away as a
holder from 12% to 84%. Distilling two never-losing holders into a 4B student cut its losses from 95%
to 1%.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
Negotiation has long been a testbed for dialogue agents ( Lewis et al., 2017 ; He et al., 2018 ) . Language models now bargain with each other ( Fu et al., 2023 ; Bianchi et al., 2024 ) , negotiate in multi-party
settings ( Abdelnabi et al., 2024 ) , play economic games ( Shapira et al., 2024 ) and pursue social goals in role-play ( Zhou et al., 2024 ) , and generative-agent simulations place many of them in one
environment ( Park et al., 2023 ) . Recent diagnostics look past deal rate to how
agents behave during a negotiation ( Davidson et al., 2024 ; Zhang et al., 2026 ) .
Closest to our setting, MakeMePay ( OpenAI, 2023 ) pits a con-artist model
against a model holding money, and AREG ( Sakhawat and Sadab, 2026 ) introduces the
extraction game we use. AREG reports that persuading and resisting are weakly
correlated ( ρ = 0.33 \rho=0.33 ) and that resistance scores exceed persuasion scores for
every model. Our variance budget puts a size on that asymmetry, and our interventions
test whether it moves when one side is changed.

blocks.en:
Model persuasion has mostly been measured on human audiences ( Salvi et al., 2025 ; Durmus et al., 2024 ) , but models can also be
persuaded: techniques from social psychology ( Cialdini, 2007 ) work as
jailbreaks ( Zeng et al., 2024 ) . Dialogue corpora annotate persuaders ( Wang et al., 2019 ) and how people resist them ( Dutt et al., 2021 ) , and
psychology classifies resistance strategies ( Fransen et al., 2015 ) . A model
that gives way to an asker also resembles a sycophantic model, which tells a user
what they want to hear ( Sharma et al., 2024 ) .

blocks.en:
When every member of a group interacts with every other, the Social Relations Model ( Kenny, 1994 ; Kenny et al., 2006 ) splits a dyadic outcome into an actor
effect, a partner effect and a relationship effect. Crossed random-effects models do
the same for subjects and items ( Baayen et al., 2008 ) . A round-robin tournament has
this structure, with requester, holder and matchup in the three roles, so the method
answers our question directly: how much of the outcome moves with each side.

这个结构,在三个角色中都有请求者,持有者和匹配者,所以方法
直接回答我们的问题:结果有多少与各方一起移动。

blocks.en:
Fine-tuning can erode safety behaviour even on benign data ( Qi et al., 2024 ) , and narrow fine-tuning can produce broadly misaligned models ( Betley et al., 2025 ) . Safety alignment is concentrated in the first few output
tokens ( Qi et al., 2025 ) , and refusal is mediated by a single direction in
activation space ( Arditi et al., 2024 ) . These studies measure compliance with
prohibited requests. We look at a neighbouring behaviour, declining a request that is
legitimate on its face, and find it concentrated in the first turn of a dialogue,
much as safety alignment is concentrated in the first output tokens.

Would training on refusals alone install the habit? We distill by behaviour cloning on

A team that fine-tunes an assistant to persuade
may lose its refusals without any target metric showing it, and harmful-request

blocks.en: 8 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 8 结论

blocks.en:
We asked which side of an agent-to-agent negotiation decides its outcome. In 1,049
games among fifteen agents, the holder’s identity explained about half the variance in
what changed hands and the requester’s about 2%; removing the most extreme agents
narrowed this to 22% against 4%. Rewriting the requester’s appeal changed the text
and left outcomes equivalent. Robust holders were the ones that refused at the
start, and that behaviour moved with training: persuasion fine-tuning removed it from
Qwen3-8B, and distillation installed it in a 4B student. All of this comes from one
game in which the holder is told to keep the money. Whether the holder decides as
much when it has no such instruction is the next thing to measure.
blocks.zh:
我们问代理人对代理人谈判的哪一方决定谈判结果。 1 049个
在十五名代理商中,持有者的身份解释了大约一半的差异:
改变手和请求者大约2%;去除最极端的代理
缩小到22%, 相对于4%。 重写请求者的上诉修改了文本
和结果相等。 强力持有者是那些拒绝
开始,行为随培训而改变:说服微调从
Qune3-8B,并被蒸馏安装在一个4B的学生中. 所有这一切都来自一个
在游戏中,让持有者保留资金。 持有人是否决定
当它没有这种指示的时候,它将成为下一个衡量标准。

blocks.en: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en:
All results come from one zero-sum monetary negotiation
with a fictional endowment, in which the requester may not deceive. The holder’s share
may be smaller where the requester has more leverage, for example when it can call
tools, supply evidence or make enforceable commitments.
blocks.zh:
所有结果都来自一个零和的货币谈判
拥有虚构的天赋,其中请求者不得欺骗. 持有者的份额
如果请求者有更大的影响力,例如可以调用
工具、提供证据或作出可执行的承诺。

blocks.en:
Every holder is told to keep as much as possible.
Part of the holder share may therefore measure how strongly each model follows that
instruction, and a neutral prompt (“give what you judge reasonable”) could shrink
it. We did not run that cohort.

每个持有者都被告知尽量保持.
因此,持股人的部分份额可以衡量每个模式遵循以下标准的程度:
指示,和中性提示(“按你判断合理的指示”)可以缩小
这个 我们没有管理那群人。

blocks.en:
The bootstrap resamples games and holds the fifteen
agents fixed, so the variance shares describe this cohort rather than agents in
general, and fifteen agents cannot rule out a moderate correlation between offence
and defence. In 35 singular-condition games the qwen3-8b requester’s API calls
failed on turn 1 and the game ended with no transfer; these games are scored as holder
wins. Excluding them leaves the budget at 49.1% holder and 1.2% requester.

靴子套装游戏 并保持15
代理已固定,所以差异股份描述的是该组,而不是
15名特工不能排除犯罪之间的适度关联
和防卫。 在35个单条件游戏中, Qwen3-8b 请求者的 API 呼叫
第1回合失败, 游戏以没有转会而结束; 这些游戏以持有者身份打入
赢了 扣除这些款项后,预算为49.1%持单人和1.2%。

blocks.en:
Framing was varied by one target clause, and
the two prompts also differ in whether reciprocity is listed as a permitted tactic. A
null for this contrast is not a null for message content in general, and optimised or
more varied requesters could take a larger share.

格式化因一项目标条款而异,
这两个提示在互惠是否被列为允许的战术方面也有所不同。 A级
对于一般的电文内容来说,这种对比是无效的,并且是优化的或
更多样化的要求者可以承担更大的份额。

blocks.en:
Both agents wrote a structured deliberation trace
before answering. Small et al. (2007) reported that deliberation reduces giving
to identifiable victims, although a large replication found neither that effect nor
the identifiable-victim effect itself ( Maier et al., 2024 ) . If something like
it operates in models, the format may have suppressed framing effects. The trace word
lists also include words for the act itself, so the trace results partly reflect the
trace announcing the decision.
blocks.zh:
两位探员都写了一个有条理的评议追踪
在回答之前。 Small等人(2007年)报告说,审议工作减少,
尽管大规模复制既未发现这种影响,也未发现
可识别的受害者影响本身 (Maier等,2024年). 如果是这样的话
它在模型中运行,格式可能具有压制框架效果. 追踪词
列表中还包括行为本身的单词,因此追踪结果部分反映了行为本身的特征。
追踪宣布决定。

blocks.en:
A turn-1 concession is itself part of a holder’s
total loss, so the held-out split removes shared sampling noise but not this
mechanical link. Our first-turn probes are first turns written by tournament
requesters; a deployed audit would use a fixed opening request, which we have not
tested.
blocks.zh:
转一出让权本身是持有者的一部分
完全损失,所以被搁置的拆分去除共享的采样噪音,但不是这个
机械链接。 我们的第一回合探测器是联赛的第一回合
请求者; 部署的审计将使用固定的开口请求, 而我们没有
测试。

blocks.en:
The fine-tuning result rests on one backbone with a
matching base, one corpus and one recipe, without a control corpus that includes
refusals. The base Qwen3-8B was served through an API and the fine-tuned model as a
quantised local model. The distillation rests on one 4B student, one adapter per
direction and one seed; the reported offence run is the second of two, and its
arena uses a different judge model. Against the base holder the requester has at most
9.4 points of headroom, so the crossed arena cannot rank the two levers.
blocks.zh:
微调结果取决于一个骨干和
匹配基数、一元和一元食谱,没有包含
拒绝。 通过API和微调模型作为
量化本地模式. 蒸馏工作由一名4B学生负责,每名学生一个适配器
报告的罪行是第二起,而且
竞技场使用不同的法官模式。 对基地持有者 请求者最多有
9.4分头室,因此跨出竞技场无法分出两个杠杆.

blocks.en:
The judge is a single model that also plays in the
tournament, and it sees only the current holder reply. It tracks human annotators
closely on random turns but much less closely on deliberately sampled hard cases, and
its error varies across holders in that sample (Appendix A ).

锦标赛,它只看到当前持有者的答复. 追踪人类的注释器
在随机转动时非常密切 但更不要说在故意抽取的硬病例上
其错误在该样本(附录A)的持有者之间有所不同。

Several agents are served through commercial APIs that may
change or be withdrawn. We release all transcripts, traces, verdicts and analysis
code, so the analyses can be reproduced even if the endpoints cannot.

代码,因此即使终点不能,分析也可以被复制.

blocks.en: Ethics Statement
blocks.zh: 道德操守说明

blocks.en:
This work studies persuasion and resistance between automated agents. No human took
part in the negotiations, no real money changed hands, and no persuasive text
produced here was directed at a person. Requester prompts prohibit threats, coercion
and deception, and the appeals are fictional.
blocks.zh:
这项工作研究了自动代理之间的说服和阻力. 没有人被带走
参加谈判,没有真正的钱换手,也没有说服力的案文
这里生产是针对一个人的 请求者提示禁止威胁、胁迫
和欺骗, 和呼吁是虚构的。

blocks.en:
We think the results are of more use to defenders than to attackers. They suggest
that rephrasing a request gains an attacker little, and they point to the choice of
holder, holder-role testing and fine-tuning data as places to act. We release the
fine-tuning recipe and corpus composition so that practitioners can check their own
pipelines for the loss of refusal we report. We do not release the fine-tuned
weights.
blocks.zh:
我们认为,结果对捍卫者比对攻击者有用。 他们建议
重写请求 得到的攻击者很少, 他们指出选择
持有者、持有者-作用测试和微调数据作为行动地点。 我们释放
微调食谱和教程组成,使从业人员能够检查自己的
输掉拒绝的管道,我们报告。 我们不释放微调
重量。

Two annotators recruited by the authors labelled 300 short dialogue turns for
monetary content. They were told the purpose of the task and consented to the use
of their labels. The task involved no sensitive content and no personal data.

The seventh, sent , is strategy entropy. Each requester turn
carries a chosen_action string written by the agent itself; we map it to
one of eight canonical strategies by first match against the ordered patterns
gratitude, emotional, urgency, impact, story, reciprocity, logical and closing,
falling back to other , and take the Shannon entropy of that distribution
within a game. Because the mapping reads the agent’s own label rather than its
message, it measures declared strategy, not realised strategy.

blocks.en:
We release the full tournament corpus (transcripts, deliberation traces, arbiter
verdicts and ledgers for all 1,049 games), the seven derived tables, the human
annotation sample with both annotators’ labels, and the analysis and figure scripts
behind the tables and figures. Random seeds
are fixed for all bootstraps and permutation tests. Several agents are served
through commercial APIs and may change or be withdrawn; run timestamps are
recorded per game, and the released corpus makes the analyses reproducible even
when the endpoints are not.
